The only code_review approval is from s.santos@fernbrook.example, which the directory lists as an address of Sofia Santos, the author (sofia.santos@fernbrook.example). Self-approval doesn't count, so there is no independent change_approver approval.

payments.py holds code covered by ledger entries ACR-0401 (required_approvals) and ACR-0403 (release). Those functions are unchanged; the change only adds a new function, approvals_remaining, so the evidence doesn't lapse.

summary: The change adds a read-only approvals_remaining helper and unit tests to payments payments.
